takeaways: Take a Nurse has a complete, unused 2026 photo and video shoot, so the case study can go from brand-only to full production proof. Put Hero Video v1 (4K founder film, captioned) on work/take-a-nurse as the main video and use the text-free Loop.mp4 as the header background; its 0:05 porch walk-up or 0:20 hand-on-hand shot can add a human healthcare beat to the homepage hero loop. For the cover use Touched Photos #180 (Touched up-253.jpg: nurse and couple laughing over the pill organizer), and build the gallery from #216, #278, #748, #758, #614, #373 (dog greeting at the door) plus founder portrait #21. Use the main Take a Nurse/Touched Photos IDs (Jason's folder is a duplicate), and skip the rough cut, lower-thirds track and raw S-Log clips. The shoot also belongs on service:content-development as proof of a full photo+video day for a small healthcare business.
